crossRefs.note: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.
Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because…
They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are…
If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging…
For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

translations.web: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
translations.bsb: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
translations.kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
translations.asv: He that saith he is in the light and hateth his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
